# m3u8dl

> A multi-threaded m3u8 video downloader written in Go.

## Purpose of this file

This `llms.txt` is written for **users who want to download, install and use
m3u8dl** — humans and the AI assistants/agents that act on their behalf. It is a
compact, machine-readable quickstart: focus on *how to obtain and drive the
tool*, not on source code. If you are instead developing the codebase, see
[`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md), which is scoped to the project's developers.

m3u8dl downloads an m3u8 playlist's TS segments concurrently, supports AES
decryption, nested/master playlists, ad dedup and resume-from-breakpoint, then
merges them into a single MP4 using system `ffmpeg` (built-in merge fallback).

## Core Facts

- License: MIT
- Language: Go (Go 1.27+), cobra for the CLI
- Module: `github.com/dingdayu/m3u8dl`
- Install: `go install github.com/dingdayu/m3u8dl@latest`
- Repo: https://github.com/dingdayu/m3u8dl
- Docs (human): https://github.com/dingdayu/m3u8dl/blob/main/README.md
- Docs (简体中文): https://github.com/dingdayu/m3u8dl/blob/main/README.zh.md

## Install (binaries)

Pre-built binaries (linux/darwin/windows × amd64/arm64) are on the **Releases**
page, published as archives: `.tar.gz` on Linux/macOS, `.zip` on Windows.
Archive naming is `m3u8dl_<ver>_<OS>_<ARCH>.tar.gz` (or `.zip` on Windows)
where `<OS>` is `Linux` / `Darwin` / `Windows` and amd64 is written as
`x86_64`. E.g. `m3u8dl_1.2.3_Linux_x86_64.tar.gz`.

For users in China/slow networks, prefer the **npm** channel (mirrored by
npmmirror.com / Alibaba) or the jsDelivr CDN (Cloudflare/Fastly-backed) — both
are verifiable; see `README.zh.md#国内加速下载` and the verification section
in `README.md`.

```bash
go install github.com/dingdayu/m3u8dl@latest
```

## Install (npm)

`m3u8dl` is published to npm as a meta package that auto-selects the correct
pre-built binary for darwin-arm64 / darwin-x64 / linux-arm64 / linux-x64 /
win32-x64:

```bash
npm install -g m3u8dl                    # global CLI
npx m3u8dl --url <m3u8-url> --json       # one-shot
# China mirror:
npm install -g m3u8dl --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com
```

The platform binaries are also on jsDelivr:
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/m3u8dl-<platform>@<version>/bin/m3u8dl`
(e.g. `m3u8dl-linux-x64`).

## Verifying releases

Release artifacts are attested a few ways, all verifiable without extra
tooling beyond `gh`/`npm`: SHA-256 `checksums.txt`, GitHub Artifact
Attestations (`gh attestation verify <file> --repo dingdayu/m3u8dl`), and npm
provenance (`npm audit signatures`). Verify before installing; see README.md
"Verifying downloads".

## Quick Usage

Always prefer `--json`; results print to **stdout**, logs to **stderr**:

```bash
m3u8dl --url https://example.com/index.m3u8 --json
# {"ok":true,"path":".../movie.mp4","duration_sec":12.3,"mode":"single",...}
```

Common flags:

| Flag | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-u/--url` | m3u8 URL (or first positional arg) | — |
| `-n/--threads` | download concurrency | 24 |
| `-o/--output` | output filename (no ext) | `movie` |
| `--host-type` | v1 / v2 / auto host resolution | `v2` |
| `--purge-dup` | remove ad/duplicate segments | off |
| `--save-path` | output directory | current dir |
| `-j/--json` | structured JSON result | off |
| `-l/--list` | batch list file, one URL per line | — |
| `-s/--insecure` | allow insecure TLS | off |

Exit code is non-zero on failure. On partial failure, the ts directory is kept;
re-running the same command resumes only the missing segments.

## Tips for automation

- Prefer `--json` and parse only stdout (`ok:true` == success).
- `--threads` trades speed vs. server friendliness (default 24).
- For many URLs, use `--list file.txt` (one m3u8 URL per line).
- Always check the exit code; it is non-zero on failure.
- If a run fails partway, the ts directory is kept — re-running the same command
	fetches only the missing segments (resume).
